'''Walking Carpet Bounty Hunter Inc.''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Walking Carpet]]
* '''Published:''' 5 June 2004 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS6]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Court Of The Vile Gangster / I Shall Enjoy Watching You Die|EJP-D-courtofthevilegangster.gif|label=Court Of The Vile Gangster}}
* '''Starting Interrupt:''' {{CardLink|Prepared Defenses|DS2-D-prepareddefenses.gif}}
* '''Starting Effect:''' {{CardLink|Sudden Impact (V) (Virtual Set 5)|VS5O-47-Sudden_Impact.png|label=Sudden Impact (V)}}
* '''Strategy:''' Court Of The Vile Gangster
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS6 Vile Carpet DS 2004 GPN.txt |Download]] (omits Jabba's Influence (V), Sudden Impact (V), Bossk (V), IG-88 (V), Boba Fett (V), Lando Calrissian (V), Rodian (V), Djas Puhr (V), Desilijic Tattoo (V), Ability, Ability, Ability (V), Imperial Decree (V), Krayt Dragon Bones (V), Close Call (V), Levitation Attack (V), A Dark Time For The Rebellion (V), Oo-ta Goo-ta, Solo? (V): no GEMP blueprint)

== Introduction ==

This is a CLASSIC attempt at a NO-flip Court.

== Notes ==

* Starting line '3rd effect – see strategy section' is a placeholder (the strategy picks one of Imperial Decree (V), Krayt Dragon Bones (V), Secret Plans or Ability x3 (V), all listed under Effects); not a card.
* Cards under Sudden Impact (V), outside the 60: Bubo x2, Droid Detector, Restraining Bolt, Wampa (V) (VS4).
* Lando Calrissian (V) dested the VS6 Dark slip; ovs_pick returned Lando Calrissian (V) (Virtual Set 15) (Light) for this date. Oo-ta Goo-ta, Solo? (V) dested VS3, not the VS10 ovs_pick returned.
* Posted 'There Will Be Hell To Pay' dested There'll Be Hell To Pay; 'Omni Box' Ommni Box; Secret Plans the Special Edition Effect.
* Duplicates of unique characters as posted: IG-88 (V), Boba Fett (V), Ephant Mon, Jodo Kast, Bane Malar x2 each.

== Strategy ==

Strategy:

This deck was inspired by a couple of Scott Lingrell’s decks.

Starting Effects:

Imperial Decree (V) vs. Force Choke Decks

Krayt Dragon Bones (V) vs. Profit

Secret Plans vs. Mind What You Have Learned

Ability, Ability, Ability (V) vs. Everything Else

Unusual Card Choices:

Uncertain is the Future – A lot of decks use starting effects to pull cards out of their reserved before the game starts (i.e., Strike Planning).  This card is to, hopefully, place it back into their decks after they have already used their ability.  Also, if you happen to not start with this you can pull it with Unexpected Interruption.  You will have enough Force (5) to pull it off without having to worry about not receiving any from your opponent.

Levitation Attack (V) – This is in here in order to pull Droid Detector and Restraining Bolt from under your starting effect.  This will hopefully be effective versus Profit decks that try to set up A Gift using Threepio and the odd Rescue the Princess to keep Artoo or 8D8 away from the Detention Block Corridor.

Set For Stun – This is here to remove any annoying characters that may come a knocking to the Audience Chamber (notably Leia, Rebel Princess).

Setup:

Use Audience Chamber’s text to pull Jabba and then use Jabba’s Influence to pull either Lyn Me or Rodian (V) to start getting your Bounty Hunters out.

There really isn’t much to playing this deck, just try to keep your opponent off balance and out-drain and out-battle him/her.
